WITH 
-- Balls bowled per player
balls_bowled AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),
-- Runs conceded per player (sum of all runs when bowler is bowling)
runs_conceded AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler AS player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
-- Economy rate
economy AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.player_id,
        (COALESCE(rc.runs_conceded, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(bb.balls_bowled, 0)) * 6 AS economy_rate
    FROM balls_bowled bb
    LEFT JOIN runs_conceded rc ON bb.player_id = rc.player_id
),
-- Wickets taken per player with runs given per match
bowler_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler AS player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN wt.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS wickets,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_given
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
        AND bb.bowler = wt.player_out
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
-- Best bowling performance (most wickets, then fewest runs) - get max wickets per player
best_wickets_per_player AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        MAX(wickets) AS max_wickets
    FROM bowler_per_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
-- Best bowling runs for players with their max wickets
best_bowling_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bwp.player_id,
        MIN(bpm.runs_given) AS best_runs
    FROM best_wickets_per_player bwp
    JOIN bowler_per_match bpm ON bwp.player_id = bpm.player_id 
        AND bwp.max_wickets = bpm.wickets
    GROUP BY bwp.player_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        bwp.player_id,
        CONCAT(bwp.max_wickets, '-', bbr.best_runs) AS best_performance
    FROM best_wickets_per_player bwp
    JOIN best_bowling_runs bbr ON bwp.player_id = bbr.player_id
),
-- Balls faced per player
balls_faced AS (
    SELECT 
        striker AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY striker
),
-- Runs scored per player per match
player_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker AS player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bs.runs_scored IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
-- Total runs per player
total_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM player_runs_per_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
-- Highest score and high score counts
highest_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        MAX(match_runs) AS highest_score,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 END) AS high_100,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 END) AS high_50,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 30 THEN 1 END) AS high_30
    FROM player_runs_per_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
-- Dismissals per player
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS dismissal_count
    FROM wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),
-- Most frequent role per player
most_freq_role AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        role,
        COUNT(*) AS role_count
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
top_role AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        role AS most_frequent_role
    FROM most_freq_role mr
    WHERE role_count = (
        SELECT MAX(role_count) FROM most_freq_role mr2 WHERE mr2.player_id = mr.player_id
    )
),
-- Matches played per player
matches_played AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
-- Total wickets per player
total_wickets_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler AS player_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN wt.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS total_wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
        AND bb.bowler = wt.player_out
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
-- Combined stats
combined_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        p.batting_hand,
        p.bowling_skill,
        COALESCE(tr.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
        mp.match_count AS total_matches,
        COALESCE(d.dismissal_count, 0) AS total_dismissals,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(d.dismissal_count, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(tr.total_runs, 0) * 1.0 / d.dismissal_count
            ELSE NULL
        END AS batting_average,
        hhs.highest_score,
        hhs.high_30,
        hhs.high_50,
        hhs.high_100,
        bf.total_balls_faced,
        CASE 
            WHEN bf.total_balls_faced > 0 THEN COALESCE(tr.total_runs, 0) * 1.0 / bf.total_balls_faced * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS strike_rate,
        COALESCE(tw.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets,
        e.economy_rate,
        bb.best_performance,
        trl.most_frequent_role
    FROM player p
    LEFT JOIN matches_played mp ON p.player_id = mp.player_id
    LEFT JOIN total_runs tr ON p.player_id = tr.player_id
    LEFT JOIN dismissals d ON p.player_id = d.player_id
    LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON p.player_id = bf.player_id
    LEFT JOIN total_wickets_cte tw ON p.player_id = tw.player_id
    LEFT JOIN economy e ON p.player_id = e.player_id
    LEFT JOIN best_bowling bb ON p.player_id = bb.player_id
    LEFT JOIN highest_scores hhs ON p.player_id = hhs.player_id
    LEFT JOIN top_role trl ON p.player_id = trl.player_id
)
SELECT 
    player_id,
    player_name,
    most_frequent_role,
    batting_hand,
    bowling_skill,
    total_runs,
    total_matches,
    total_dismissals,
    batting_average,
    highest_score,
    high_30,
    high_50,
    high_100,
    total_balls_faced,
    strike_rate,
    total_wickets,
    economy_rate,
    best_performance
FROM combined_stats
ORDER BY player_id;

# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.
